pointsOfInterest.name: Sinkport City Spaceport
pointsOfInterest.description: The main spaceport of Sinkport, a chaotic hub where ships from across the galaxy dock. Smugglers, traders, and criminals all pass through here. Customs enforcement is... flexible.

pointsOfInterest.name: Sinkport City
pointsOfInterest.description: The sprawling urban center of Sinkport, a chaotic mix of towering skyscrapers, neon-lit streets, and shadowy alleys. The heart of the Smuggler's Moon, where anything can be bought or sold for the right price.

pointsOfInterest.name: Sinkport City Medical Center
pointsOfInterest.description: A medical facility that serves the city, though the quality of care varies with your credits. The doctors here have seen everything and ask no questions. Some say the Vorr Cartel has a stake in it.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Entertainment District
pointsOfInterest.description: A neon-soaked district filled with casinos, nightclubs, cantinas, and all manner of vices. The lights never dim here, and credits flow like water. Home to the galaxy's most extravagant gambling halls and dangerous pleasures.

pointsOfInterest.name: Umbra Casino
pointsOfInterest.description: One of the most opulent casinos on Sinkport, owned by the Umbra crime syndicate. High-stakes games, exclusive clientele, and rumors of rigged tables. Only the wealthy or foolish enter here.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Red Light District
pointsOfInterest.description: A district where every vice is available for a price. Bars, clubs, and establishments of questionable legality line the streets. The Vorr Cartel maintains order here, but it's a thin veneer.

pointsOfInterest.name: Vorr Palace Complex
pointsOfInterest.description: A massive complex controlled by the Vorr Cartel, where the crime lords conduct their business. Lavish on the outside, deadly on the inside. Only those with proper connections dare enter.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Velvet Room
pointsOfInterest.description: An upscale cantina in the upper levels where the wealthy and powerful gather. Expensive drinks, exclusive clientele, and deals worth millions. The perfect place to network with the elite of the criminal underworld.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Data Vault
pointsOfInterest.description: An information broker's headquarters where secrets are bought and sold. If you need to know something, someone here knows it. The price is always high, but the information is usually worth it.

pointsOfInterest.name: Bounty Hunter's Guild Hall
pointsOfInterest.description: The official headquarters of the Bounty Hunter's Guild on Sinkport. Bounty contracts are posted here, and the galaxy's deadliest hunters gather to claim their targets. Not a place for the faint of heart.

pointsOfInterest.name: Wyrm's Arsenal
pointsOfInterest.description: The most well-stocked weapons dealer on Sinkport. From pulsers to vibroblades, if it can kill, it's sold here. The owner has connections to every major arms manufacturer in the galaxy.

pointsOfInterest.name: Tech Bazaar
pointsOfInterest.description: A bustling market specializing in technology, droids, and cybernetics. Everything from legal tech to illegal modifications is available. The perfect place to upgrade your gear or find rare components.

pointsOfInterest.name: Stellar Ship Chandlery
pointsOfInterest.description: A massive ship parts and equipment dealer. Smugglers and pirates come here to upgrade their vessels with illegal modifications. The owner turns a blind eye to questionable transactions.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Lower Levels
pointsOfInterest.description: The dark, dangerous underbelly of Sinkport. Home to gangs, criminals, and those who have fallen through the cracks. Few who venture here return unchanged, and many don't return at all.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Smuggler's Den
pointsOfInterest.description: A notorious cantina in the lower levels where smugglers, pirates, and outlaws gather. Information flows freely here, but so do pulser bolts. The perfect place to find work or trouble.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Black Market
pointsOfInterest.description: An illegal trading hub where stolen goods, weapons, spice, and other contraband are bought and sold openly. Vorr-controlled and heavily guarded, but the deals here are worth the risk.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Spice Den
pointsOfInterest.description: A seedy establishment where spice is consumed openly and deals are made in the shadows. The air is thick with smoke and desperation. A dangerous place, but information can be valuable here.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Pit
pointsOfInterest.description: An underground fighting arena where gladiators, beasts, and desperate fighters battle for credits and glory. Blood sport at its finest, with betting on every match. Only the strong survive.

pointsOfInterest.name: Smuggler's Landing
pointsOfInterest.description: An unofficial landing zone in the lower levels where smugglers dock their ships away from prying eyes. No questions asked, but no guarantees either. Perfect for those who prefer to stay off the grid.

pointsOfInterest.name: Back Alley Clinic
pointsOfInterest.description: A sketchy medical facility in the lower levels that operates outside official channels. Cheap, fast, and discrete. Perfect for those who can't afford the main medical center or need to avoid official records.

pointsOfInterest.name: Gang Territory
pointsOfInterest.description: A section of the lower levels controlled by rival gangs. Constant turf wars, drive-by shootings, and open warfare. Only the desperate or the heavily armed venture here. Potential for high-risk, high-reward opportunities.
